description: Modifies how Minecraft creates Nether Portals. The scale of the overworld and nether is now dependent on the difference in center positions and size of the world borders. This is useful for small world border survival games.

mods.name: Smarter Nether Portals
mods.description: This mod fixes the scaling and centering problem found with small world border sizes. If a portal is created in a small world border far away from another, this mod will prevent it from appearing at the edge of the other dimension's world border
